semanticReview: Four-gate capable predicate is separate from current VM ownership
Saved disable flag is not presented as a fresh global read
ACS policy acceptance is not claimed as proof of physical isolation
Conditional RMRR check is placed before the selected owner scan
Owner scan preserves self-representative bypass and per-record skips
Same owner is not equated with full power-on success or complete VM configuration
Existing-domain guard retains selected-path and status-code boundaries
Registration and activation are separate entry points
Unknown configOption business name remains G
Prior runtime and version evidence is not described as newly executed
Global disable flag distinguished from per-device blacklist
IOMMU enabled and per-device support distinguished from ACS path isolation
Linux comparison pinned to upstream v6.6 and separately identifies repository ACS override patch
API dispatch, per-dependent validation coverage and runtime rebind are explicitly unresolved
Configured owner writes distinguished from active state and VM ownership
Existing API receipts re-read for both enable and disable results
Linux iommu_group is not equated with VMware dependentDevice or address domain
Generic Linux v6.6 grouping is distinguished from VFIO hot-reset dev_set constraints
Same-topology Linux outcomes are conditional source-based deductions, not invented runtime observations
VMware configuration, host-owner precheck, VMM-owner scan and alias-domain switching ranges are separated
M07 endpoint/root/downstream type paths and conditional ACS masks are preserved
Intel ACS Control offset quirk is a register-layout adjustment, not unconditional admission
Software bypass and cached verdict are not claimed to create hardware isolation
Common probe associates the result with the original device, not the moved search cursor
Intel and AMD PCI wrappers both select pci_device_group in the pinned v6.6 sources
Alias callback checks the PCI object group and does not use numeric alias for a group-table lookup
Upstream path check happens before moving the cursor to the bridge and covers the whole path to root
Peer alias predicate uses OR across directions, not a requirement for mutual alias entries
NULL helper result means no existing group found, not an isolation certificate
Both recursive helpers share one same-bus devfn bitmap; allocation errors do not register a group
ACS override influence is localized to path and multifunction ACS verdicts, not explicit DMA alias enumeration
Walkthroughs are source-based examples with stated starting state; no invented sysfs observation

linuxSourceFlow.method: Fetched fixed v6.6 sources; independently recomputed Git blob SHA-1, SHA-256 and selected line hashes
